newsitem.title: UK: Brent dates clocked to Shell, Sinochem - traders.
newsitem.headline: Brent dates clocked to Shell, Sinochem - traders.

text.p: Both Brent cargoes turning wet on Monday were five o'clocked, with one going to Shell and the other to China's Sinochem, traders said.
The two cargoes were both due to load Sept 2-4, though one was originally a Sept 1-3 cargo that was clocked to trading house Cargill and then deferred.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.

A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8060
